utterances.text: Mr. Mundis, the Registry suggests that if you have a hard copy, you use that also, because the system is a bit slow with photographs. Maybe you can move a little faster if you have hard copies, but the rest of us will look at the system.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I do, in fact, have a hard copy set of the photographs; and, perhaps, in light of doing that, it might also be helpful if the witness were simply to mark the names of those persons that he does recognise on them here in the courtroom, which then when they're scanned in will have the names as well.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: If you can just pass them to your learned colleagues to see that, in fact, no name is already written on them. I beg your pardon. The suggestion is they be put on the ELMO. Good. Sorry.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Okay. Mr. Begovic, you now have, I believe, about 22 photographs in front of you on the ELMO, the machine to your right, and I would ask you, sir, if - and I stress the word "if" - you recognise any of these photographs, if you would please tell us who is depicted in the photograph and how you know who that person is; and then we'll ask you to write the name of that person on -- underneath the photograph. Do you understand what I'm asking you to do, sir?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: The first photograph that you see in front of you, can you recognise that person?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, I can.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And who is it, sir?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Sheikh Enver.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And does Sheikh Enver have a last name or a family name, to the best of your knowledge?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I believe it was Saban.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, sir, how do you know Sheikh Enver Saban?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Well, we saw him in our unit.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Did he have a role or a function in your unit?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Well, he certainly did.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And what role or function was that?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: He was among the people who were in charge of the detachment, if not the person in charge. I cannot remember.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can you write his name, please, underneath the photograph?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: You want the name on the hard copy or do you want it on the screen?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: On the hard copy, since he's got that in front of him, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I would ask for some direction from perhaps the Court Officer or the Trial Chamber. I'm going to ask that all the photographs that he recognises be admitted, and I'm not sure if we want to do that one by one or if you want them to go in as a bundle.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Let him mark them and then we can scan them in.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: So they'll go in as one exhibit?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: That's fine.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Sir, if you could then turn to the next photograph, and I would ask you, again, if you recognise the person in these three photographs.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: It is the same person, Sheikh Enver.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Could you again write his name, Sheikh Enver Saban, on the bottom of that photo photograph?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And this photograph, sir?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: The same person.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Would you, again, please write his name on that photograph?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Do you recognise this person, Mr. Begovic?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: This is Abdul Aziz.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Could you please write his name on that photograph?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Do you recognise this person?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: It is the same person.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Could you please write his name on the photograph?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Do you recognise this person, sir?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Not, I don't.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Could you go to the next photograph, please?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Next photograph, please?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Next photograph, please?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Next photograph, please? Do you recognise anyone --

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Let's focus first on the top photograph.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Do you recognise anyone in that photograph, sir?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [No interpretation] [Indicating]

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: The interpreter did not hear the witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: The interpreters did not hear you, sir. Could you repeat the name of that person?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Repeat what he said.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Nusret Abdibegovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Could you put a circle around the person that you've identified in the top photograph?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Like this. [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Just a circle right around his image in the photo, so that you're not circling anybody else.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And on the margin on the left-hand side, if you could write his name?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Here, under the photograph? [Indicating]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: That's fine. If you could write his name, please.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Now, can you please just draw a line from that name up to the circle, so that there's no confusion as to what it is you've labelled?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Can you tell the Trial Chamber Nusret Abdibegovic is?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: He is currently the Mufti in Travnik.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, sir, do you know what function he was holding or what position he was in, in the period 1993 to 1995?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I don't know that.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: In the top photograph, do you recognise any of the other individuals standing in front of or beside or behind Mufti Abdibegovic?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And in the lower photograph, do you recognise any of the people?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Just him; no one else.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Just Mufti Abdibegovic who appears in both photos.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Could we go to the next picture, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, again, the top photograph, do you recognise anybody in the top photograph?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Sakib Mahmuljin. [Indicates]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: If you could please draw a line from the person you've indicated as Sakib Mahmuljin, to the right-hand side, and then write his name over on the right-hand margin, please.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: If you could just draw a line from that name to the person that you've --

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I had drawn a line, but you can see it quite well. [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I see it now. Do you see anybody else in that photograph?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Abu Aiman.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Would you please draw a circle around Abu Aiman and write his name at the bottom, and then connect the circle to the name, please.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, Mr. Begovic, can you tell the Trial Chamber who Abu Aiman is or was?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: He was an interpreter. As far as I know, this is what he did most often.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, Mr. Begovic, what unit, if you know, what unit was Abu Aiman in, in 1993 to 1995?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: He was with the El Mujahed Detachment.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Do you recognise anyone else, sir, in the top photograph?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Here. [Indicating] We again have Nusret, Efendi Abdibegovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: If you could, again, sir, draw or write his name on the left-hand margin, and draw and arrow to the person you have indicated as Mufti Abdibegovic; and perhaps an arrow, again, as well, please.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Do you recognise anyone else in the photograph?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And in the bottom photograph, sir?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Next photograph, please.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: This is Abu Haris and Abdul Melik. [Indicating]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Again, sir, same procedure, if you could draw circles and then draw arrows to the person that you've identified.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And can you tell the Trial Chamber -- we've already talked about Abu Haris. Abdul Melik, can you tell the Trial Chamber who Abdul Melik was?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: He was an interpreter.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Where was he from; do you know?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I don't know for sure. I think some place around Donji Vakuf.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: But just so the record is clear, Abdul Melik was a Bosnian, isn't that correct, a Bosniak?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And when you say he was an "interpreter," what language or languages did he interpret in? What languages did he speak other than Bosnian?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: He could speak Arabic and, of course, Bosnian, and he interpreted from Arabic into Bosniak.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can we have the next photograph, please?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. Begovic, do you recognise anybody in this photograph?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: It is Abu Haris on both photographs, but I don't know who this other person is.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Again, sir, if you could please write "Abu Haris" in the margin and draw an arrow to the person you recognise as Abu Haris.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: May I ask the witness to please try and write legibly, something that we can be able to read. That "S" in "Haris" that that is now on the screen doesn't look like an "S" at all; neither does the "U." You know, try to write clearly, sir. We are going to be reading these documents months after today. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Next photograph, please. Do you recognise anyone in these photos?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Abu Haris, Abdul Melik.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Again, if you could, just perhaps one time -- it's stills from a from a videotape. So if you could identify them once, I think that would be sufficient.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: The next photograph, please. Do you recognise this individual?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: This is a person I know from television. He's Abu Hamza, and half of Bosnia knows him. I never saw him in the detachment. I've never met him, and I didn't know him before, but I knew him in later times.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Could you please write "Abu Hamza" underneath his photograph, please.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: The next photograph, please. Do you recognise this individual?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Abu Aiman.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Could you please write his name under the photograph?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Next photograph, please. Do you recognise this person, sir?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Abdul Melik --

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Could you please write his name under the photograph?

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's correction: "Abu Maali."

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Next photograph, please. Do you recognise that individual, sir?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Abu Maali, also.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: The next photograph, please. Do you recognise this individual?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Again -- again, it's Abu Maali.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Again, could you please write his name on the photograph?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: The next photograph, please. Do you recognise this individual?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: The next photograph, please. Do you recognise this individual?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Muatez.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Would you please write his name on the photograph, please?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Next photograph. Do you recognise this individual?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Excuse me. Do you know Muatez's other name, first name or second name, depending on what "Muatez" is?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, I don't.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. Begovic, do you recognise this individual?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, finally, do you recognise this individual?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Your Honour, we would ask that at least the bundle of photos that the witness was able to identify, perhaps we can do it that way. At this point, there's no need to admit the ones he doesn't recognise, but certainly the ones he does recognise, we would ask that those be placed into either one bundle, one exhibit; or if it's more convenient, that they be individually numbered as exhibits.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: The photographs that the witness has been able to identify are admitted into evidence. May they please be admitted as a bundle and be given a single exhibit number.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, that will be Exhibit number 68.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Next, I would ask that the witness be shown what was previously marked as PT06166. And perhaps this would be one that might be easier to do with the electronic pen. I would ask if the usher could assist.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. Begovic, do you recognise anyone in this photograph?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And can you please tell us who you recognise in this photograph?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Sheikh Enver Rahmetulali [as interpreted]; Abu Maali; Alija Izetbegovic, the late Alija Izetbegovic; and Sakib Mahmuljin.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I would ask you, sir, the transcript says Sheikh Enver "Rahmetulali," and I'm not sure if the translators were able to hear you. The "Sheik Enver" that you've made reference to, what was his full name, if you know?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I just know that he was Sheikh Enver Saban. I don't know about any other names.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Yes, Madam Vidovic.

utterances.speaker: MS. VIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, if I can be of assistance, he is saying "the late," "the late," every time he refers; and that's what he says, "the late Sheikh," and that's what should have been said.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Vidovic. Now, is it not possible for the witness to, again, identify these people and link them?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Yes. I'm going to ask him to do that, Your Honour. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Sir, Sheikh Enver Saban in this photograph, can you please place the number "1" on the person -- or if you could draw a large number "1" on the person you recognise at Sheikh Enver Saban.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: This doesn't look like a "1" for later reading. Can't he circle the head of the person and give a name on the side?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: We could do that as well.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: That would be much more helpful.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Could you please circle the head of Sheikh Enver Saban?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And maybe in the upper right corner, draw a line and write "Saban."

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And the next person, I believe, that you identified, sir, was Abu Maali. Could you please circle Abu Maali?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes. [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And write his name, please.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And the next person you recognised was the late Alija Izetbegovic. Could you please circle him and write his name on the photograph, please.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, finally, Mr. Begovic, you indicated that you recognised Sakib Mahmuljin. Could you please circle him and write his name.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, sir, I neglected to ask you earlier. Who is Sakib Mahmuljin?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: He was the commander of the 3rd Corps. That much I know.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And do you know in what time period he was the commander of the 3rd Corps, in which year or months or time frame?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No. No, I don't know that. It was towards the end of 1995 that he was on that post; but when he assumed it, I don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I would ask that this photograph be captured and that it be given an exhibit number, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Just before we do that. Do you recognise nobody else in this photograph, sir?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. The photograph is admitted into evidence. May it please be captured and given an exhibit number.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. That will be Exhibit number 69.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, perhaps, one last photograph before we take the next break, PT06170. 06170.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, again, Mr. Begovic, do you recognise any of the people in this photograph?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I would ask you, sir, if you could tell us who you recognise, and then we'll go through the same drill and have you circle their heads and write their names on the photograph.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: The late Alija Izetbegovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Circle his head and write his name, sir, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Sakib Mahmuljin; Abu Maali; Abu Aiman. [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Again, Your Honours, I would ask that this image be captured and be given an exhibit number and admitted into evidence, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: This picture is admitted into evidence. May it please be captured and be given an exhibit number.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, that will be Exhibit number 70.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I'm looking at the clock, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: You don't have anything that you can do in two minutes?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I don't think so. Perhaps we could shave off on the other end and come back at 20 minutes to 6.00, give us a 27-minute recess instead of 30.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you very much. We will take recess now and come back at 20 to 6.00. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Mr. Mundis.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. Before I continue, I did promise the Trial Chamber I would provide brief information on the provenance of Exhibit 67. This document, at least based on a facial reading of page 3, was produced by the El Mujahedin Detachment of the 3rd Corps of the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina. This document was seized by an investigator of the Tribunal on 20 January 2005 from CSB Zenica, that's the Security Services Centre in Zenica, on January 20, 2005. That's where we got the document from. I hope that satisfies Judge Harhoff.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HARHOFF
utterances.text: It does. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And before I proceed, I did speak with the Defence at the break concerning this. With respect to Exhibit 69, which was about two photos back that we looked at with the witness, in the event there's any confusion in anyone's mind, the Prosecution will state for the record that the accused is not depicted -- is not shown on that photograph, in the event that there was any dispute or confusion about that. The Prosecution, having spoken to the Defence, wants to alert the Chamber to that fact, that the accused is not in any of the photographs that we've been shown today.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Mundis. We don't know the secret to the source of that; but if it was an issue between the Prosecution and the Defence, that's fine. I see Madam Vidovic smiles approvingly. Madam Vidovic, do you have any comments to make?

utterances.speaker: MS. VIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, Your Honour. And I would like to thank Mr. Mundis.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. You may proceed, Mr. Mundis.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. Begovic, let me just return to a topic we were speaking about a little bit earlier, and that is training. And you told us, when you first joined the El Mujahedin Detachment, that you underwent some training. Can you tell the Trial Chamber where this training took place?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: The training was in Orasovac --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's correction: Orahovac.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] -- and it was in a village where Croats used to live. They left after the military operation. And while undergoing the training there, we were billeted in a couple of houses.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's note: The village name is Orasac.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Other than this period when you were in Orasac, did you undergo any additional training during the time period you were with the El Mujahedin Detachment?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, perhaps, I should have asked you this earlier, sir, but for how long did you remain a member of the El Mujahedin Detachment after joining the end of July, beginning of August, 1993?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Until the end of the war, or rather, until the Dayton Accords were signed.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And can you give the Trial Chamber a date that you were demobilised or at least a month and year that you left that unit?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: 1995, the time of the Dayton Accords. I don't know the exact date.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Do you remember what month of 1995 you left the unit?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Now, are you familiar with a location or a building known as Vatrostalna?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can you tell the Trial Chamber where this building is located?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: The building is in the outskirts of Zenica. It is in the territory of Zenica Municipality.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Can the witness speak a bit closer to the microphone for the interpreters, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Sir, they're asking if you can perhaps move a little bit closer to the microphones or perhaps speak a little louder for the benefit of the interpreters.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can you tell the Trial Chamber, Mr. Begovic, why you are familiar with the Vatrostalna building?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: For a while, our command was moved there; the detachment command, that is.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Do you know, approximately, when the detachment command was located in this building?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: In 1994, I think, although I cannot be more precise.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And how long did the detachment command remain in the Vatrostalna building after moving there?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Until the end of the war.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can you tell us, sir, other than the location at Orasac and Zapode and Vatrostalna, whether there were any other locations where the El Mujahedin Detachment had camps or headquarters or training locations?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Are you familiar, sir, with a location known as the 13-kilometre camp?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Did you ever go to that location?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Do you recall, approximately, how many times you went to that location?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I don't know. On several occasions. I don't know how many, though.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Again, can you approximate? Was it five, ten, fifteen, thirty, more than a hundred? Can you give us a rough approximation?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Perhaps, around ten times, I would pass by that; probably, I would spend the night there on that occasion; and then move on.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. Begovic, do you recall --

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Do you recall the approximate time period when that location was established, when that camp was established?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Have we established that it is a camp?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. Begovic, how would you characterise the 13-kilometre installation or facility?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: The Prosecutor mentioned the word "camp." I would call it a place where we slept occasionally. There were tents. We would spend the night. I think that would be a better description of it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Well, this 13-kilometre location, do you know approximately when the El Mujahedin Detachment began using this location?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: In 1995, when we received certain assignments at Vozuca [Realtime transcript read in error "Vozuka"], perhaps, March or April 1995 --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's note: The location name is "Vozuca."

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I wonder ask if the witness could be shown Map 21 in the binder. This map bears ERN 0618-6716.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Begovic, in a moment, I'll show a close-up map of this area. But on this general map, if you're able to do so, could you indicate the approximate location - and, again, using the electronic pen - mark the approximate location of the 13-kilometre facility or location?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: This map is not large enough for me to be able to see it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Could we then go to Map 22, 0618-6717. Map 22, 0618-6717.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HARHOFF
utterances.text: Mr. Mundis, is that an excerpt of 6716?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I don't believe -- if memory serves me, I don't believe it's an excerpt. It's from a different-scale map of the same location, if I'm not mistaken. I will note, perhaps, by way of reference for the Trial Chamber, at the top of Map 22, you can see the village of Borovnica; and if you look at Map 21, Borovnica is in the centre, approximately two-thirds of the way down on that map. So, yes, it is actually an excerpt.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HARHOFF
utterances.text: I was just looking for that. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Borovnica is a reference point on comparing the two maps.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. Begovic, on this map, do you see the approximate location of the 13-kilometre facility or location?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: It says here the "12-kilometre," so if the scale is 1 to ..., it should be somewhere here. [Indicating] There was a bridge behind it. It's probably somewhere in the middle of this square.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: If you could please take the marker and indicate that by circling the approximate location, to the best of your recollection.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: This is a rather large circle, but somewhere there. [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: That's fine. If you could please write next to that the number "13" and the letters "KM."

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks] "13," and what else?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: "KM."

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Thank you very much. We ask this to be captured and be admitted into evidence and given and exhibit number, please?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. May the map be captured and be admitted into evidence, and may it please be given an exhibit number?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, that would be Exhibit number 71.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: While we are there, Mr. Mundis, Exhibit number 71 is a document 6717. You had placed earlier 6716. Are you going to do anything about that one?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Well, perhaps, if the witness is able to make any markings on that map, I'm not sure if he's able to do so, in light of his earlier answer, but we don't need -- we don't need to have a blank map.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: We'll try that with other witnesses, perhaps.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Begovic, you mentioned earlier that this location -- there were tents at this location. Can you tell the Trial Chamber whether there were any other structures, or facilities, or buildings, or anything else at this 13-kilometre location?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: There were two or three demolished houses; nothing else.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And on those occasions, when you went into that location, what were the primary reasons you went there? Why did you go into that location? What were you doing there?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Occasionally, we would sleep there. I think it was some sort of a transit centre. We would assemble there before any action, when we would be issued with weapons. It was a bit further away from the enemy lines, and it was safe. That's why the location was probably chosen.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Did you, sir, ever attend any meetings or any -- where any discussions were held concerning operations or military operations?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No, I don't know of that.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Do you know, sir, who was in charge of that location?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: One of the Arabs, but they kept rotating. I cannot say exactly.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Let me turn your attention, sir, to operations in -- military operations in 1995. Can you tell the Trial Chamber whether you were personally involved in any military operations in 1995?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Let's focus our attention, sir, on what might be considered more major or important military operations. How many such military operations were you personally involved in, in 1995?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: At Vozuca, there were three operations that I participated in, or action. I would call it an action. This is usually referred to as "operation." However, I believe an operation is a larger thing than a simple military action.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Okay. Can you give the Trial Chamber rough approximations, then, these three actions you were involved in, the time periods? When was the first action, approximately?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Approximately, in May of 1995.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And the second action, the approximate time period?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: In June -- no, in July 1995.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And the third action?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: The third one was in September 1995.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Okay. In a few moments, I'll ask you more specific questions about these three actions.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: But before we do that, I would ask that the witness be shown Map 11 from the Court binder bearing ERN number 0618-6706. That's Map 11, 0618-6706.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Now, Witness, do you see the map in front of you?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, I do, but I can't make out anything on it. It's far too small.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: If we could perhaps start with the left-hand side of the map, if we could just blow that up for a moment, please. Your Honours, in order to save time, this map, in effect, serves as an overview for what we'll be discussing with the witness for the rest of the day. And I'm going to ask him, with the Court's permission, to mark a number of locations, even though we haven't gotten in the testimony to those locations, simply so that we have an overview map of all the things he'll be talking about for the rest of the day, if that's acceptable to the Trial Chamber.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: That's acceptable if there's no objection.

utterances.speaker: MS. VIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, Your Honour, none.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: If we could then go up a little bit on the map, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Now, Witness, again, if you could take the electronic pen and circle, if you see it on the map, can you circle Zavidovici?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Should I encircle only the letters, "Zavidovici," or the entire city -- the town?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: The town, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Mr. Mundis, before the witness marks, I'm advised that once you've made the markings, you'll not be able to move the map around.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Okay. Then we'll do it in two bits, if that's acceptable.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Okay. Maybe mark what you can mark on this one and then we will --

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Exactly.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. Begovic, do you also see the village of Brezik?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I don't. Here it is. Is this what you had in mind? [Indicating]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: If you could circle Brezik, please.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, if you see the village of Livade on this map, I would ask you to circle that as well.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I don't see it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Perhaps in the upper right-hand corner?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I really don't see it. Perhaps you can direct me.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: That's okay. Do you see Stog on this map?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Here it is. [Indicating] Is this it?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Go ahead and circle Stog if you see it.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Do you see the feature known as Paljenik?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes. Here it is. [Indicating]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: If you could circle that, please.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I would ask that this image be captured and it be given an exhibit number, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: This map will be admitted into evidence --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be Exhibit number 72.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much for doing that. I was not on the microphone. I was going to say, "This map is admitted into evidence. May it please be given an exhibit number." Thank you for having done so.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And if we could then perhaps take that same map, a blank copy of that same map. If we could please have the upper -- yeah, if we could capture the kind of middle-upper part of the map. Perhaps a little bit up and a little bit to the right. That's fine.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. Begovic, do you see the map in front of you now?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Are you now able to locate the village of Livade?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Could you please circle Livade on this map.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Are you able, sir, on this map to see the village of Krcevine; and if so, could you circle that.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes. [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And if you're able, sir, to see the village of Kesten, could you please circle that.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, finally, if you're able to see the feature known as Podsjelovo. Podsjelovo. Do you see that feature on the map?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I do.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Could you please circle that feature?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I would ask, Your Honours, that this image be captured and be given an exhibit number and admitted into evidence, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: This picture is admitted into evidence. May it please be given an exhibit number.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, that will be Exhibit number 73.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Sorry. Mr. Registrar, what was Exhibit 72?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit 72 was the first part of the same map.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Oh, I beg your pardon. Okay. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. Begovic, I'd now like to turn your attention to what you described as the first action, which you told us took place in May 1995. Can you briefly tell the Trial Chamber, sir, what preparatory steps your unit took in the period immediately preceding this first action in May 1995?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: We came to the territory of Zavidovici. At first, we were housed in the houses at Livade. I think it was during the winter right after New Year's. It was cold. There were no leaves on the trees; therefore, we were unable to conduct any military activities. One could see everything. Right after our arrival, we had a simulated attack in the area of Podsjelovo. One of our soldiers was killed there, and two got wounded.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Let me just interrupt. What was the purpose of this simulated attack? Why did you simulate an attack in the area of Podsjelovo?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I don't know exactly. It was right upon our arrival. I don't know what the purpose was. From that time until May, we were preparing for the action. We were doing reconnaissance, preparing the roads. We did physical preparation, religious preparation, and everything that was necessary for us to successfully carry out that action.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And against what military force or forces was that action to be directed?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Against Serb forces.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Against the VRS?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Well, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can you tell the Trial Chamber when this action commenced?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: In May 1995; in the second half of 1995, after trees began sprouting leaves.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Immediately prior to this action starting, did you have any occasion to be in the 13-kilometre location?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: For what purpose?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: We were there before the action. We were being assigned to our respective combat groups, being issued with weapons, and so on and so forth. And from there, we proceeded to our starting points.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, Mr. Begovic, for this action in May 1995, what combat group were you assigned to?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I was in a reserve group for this action, and my emir was Fikret Murtic.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And can you briefly tell us what action the reserve group was to carry out in this action in May 1995?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Well, the reserve groups were to be fed into the line positions after the first initial stormers had charged the line and had penetrated it, and they were there then to possess it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And can you tell us about the day the action commenced? What happened on that day, from the time you woke up until the action began?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I don't know exactly at what time we set out towards Paljenik; but as we were approaching it, that is to say, before Podsjelovo, most of us were saying our morning prayers, the Sabah Namaz, and then we approached as far as we could the enemy's trenches.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: From where did you start on that day? Where did you -- where did you say your morning prayers? Where had you slept the night before?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I don't remember exactly where we were, but the morning prayers were conducted just in front of the line.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can the witness please be shown Map 18 from the Court binder. It bears ERN number 0618-6713. Map 18, 0618-6713.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Begovic, I understand it was a long time ago, but can you, on this map, identify and draw a line at the approximate location where the VRS forces were when this May 1995 action began?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Yes, Madam Vidovic.

utterances.speaker: MS. VIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Objection, Your Honour. Of course, if the witness knows that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Mr. Mundis.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Yes. I completely agree, if the witness knows. If he doesn't know, I'm sure he will tell us that he doesn't know.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Mr. Begovic.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The army of the Republika Srpska was around Podsjelovo, where it says here on the map "Podsjelovo." I could not mark their exact location. I'm unable to do that.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can you give us an approximate location of the line as it existed when the May 1995 action commenced?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Well, I'm no expert on maps. I couldn't. I'm not able to do that.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: That's fine.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Mr. Mundis, if I can just ask the witness. On this Exhibit 6713, you're saying they were around Podsjelovo. Can you mark Podsjelovo there on the map?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. I can only encircle here where it says "Podsjelovo" on the map.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Please do.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, Mr. Begovic, on the day the May 1995 action began, where was your combat group in the morning? Where did you start from?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: We set out from Livade. There was a road leading from Livade to Podsjelovo.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Would you please, if you see it on the map, underline the name of the village Livade?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Shall I encircle it?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: That's fine.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Now, you indicated that there was a road leading from Livade to Podsjelovo. What was the significance of --

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: A road, which is to say a pedestrian path, rather, a dirt road.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And what is the significance of this pedestrian path or dirt road with respect to what happened on this day in 1995?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: We executed some repairs on this road so that these four-by-fours could use it, in order for us to be able to pull out our wounded, but it was of no particular significance either before or after that particular action.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And can you tell the Trial Chamber approximately how long this action required? How long was the action on that day?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: At most, half an hour, and the forces of the Bosnian Serbs were then pushed away from the area of Podsjelovo. They were repelled.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And after these Bosnian Serb forces were repelled, where did your combat group go? What did you do?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: We were there in the field around Podsjelovo, perhaps in the centre of Podsjelovo. We stayed there for about six days. We dug trenches, we fortified our positions, and so ...

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And then where did you go after you were there for about six days?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: After having spent six days there, we were supposed to go to our respective homes for a rest, because we had spent some 30 to 40 days out in the field.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, Mr. Begovic, these positions that you fortified, what -- did any military unit take up the positions which you fortified on Podsjelovo?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: When we set out to go home for our furloughs, a unit arrived there to take up a part of the line, but also some of our own people, our own people, remained there. Now, whether it was the Zavidovici Brigade, I am not sure.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And what, sir, was your role in this first action?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I was, as I told you, an ordinary soldier, and I was on the reserve force. So I have nothing to add to that or to take away from that.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Let's turn now, Mr. Begovic, to the second action, which you told us was in July 1995. What was your role in the July 1995 military action?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: The emir of my group was killed in this action at Podsjelovo, after which I was appointed emir of that group.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And when you say, Mr. Begovic, you were "appointed emir of the group," do you remember or recall who appointed you the emir of the group?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I'm not sure. Probably Muatez, the people in charge of the detachment. At any rate, after I had returned from the rest, I was just informed that thereafter I would be the emir of that group.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And at that point in time, when you were appointed the emir of that combat group, how many men were in your combat group?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Between 15 and 20, not more.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And with respect, Mr. Begovic, to the July 1995 action, what task was your combat group assigned to carry out?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: We were assigned with the duty of penetrating the enemy lines at a certain spot and to reach a certain place.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Do you recall where you were to penetrate the enemy lines and what place you were to reach?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: The place was called Trigonometre or something like that. I don't know the exact name. We were supposed to reach the area after the village of -- we were supposed to reach the villages of Krcevine and Kesten.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I'll ask you about that in just a moment, and we'll we look at another map. But first I would like to ask you how it was -- who gave you the assignment to reach the area of Krcevine and Kesten.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: It was Muatez, our emir, who issued us these tasks.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And where were you when these tasks were assigned to you?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I did not understand the question.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: When Muatez assigned this task or these tasks to your combat group, to you, where were you?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I was with my people. I was with the group.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: How was this tasking given to you?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: We reconnoitered the area before the action. We were preparing the action like we did the time before, when we were doing it in respect of Podsjelovo. And I went many times to this place where we were supposed to carry out our attack and did some reconnoitering and preparatory action of that kind.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Okay. Let me try to make myself clear about what I'm asking you. When you got this tasking, were you in the field, were you at the 13-kilometre? Where were you when Muatez gave you this assignment to go to Krcevine and Kesten?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Muatez?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Muatez, yes.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: It was from the 13th that we were getting ready to go. That is where we were being issued with weapons and assigning people to their respective groups. It was from there that we set out. That's where we were during the night. But from which exact point we set out, I cannot remember with precision.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And when you were at the 13th kilometre, being issued weapons and assigning people, were there only soldiers of the El Mujahedin Detachment at the 13-kilometre, or were there any soldiers from any other units there immediately before the July 1995 action?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: There may have been some soldiers there, but they did not participate in the actual action with us. They may have been assigned to pull out the wounded or later to take up the line, but I don't know that.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I would ask now that the witness be shown Map 19 from the Court binder, 0618-6714. Oh, yes. Sorry. If we could capture the map on the screen, I would ask that that be admitted into evidence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: The map on the screen is admitted into evidence. May it please be given an exhibit number.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be Exhibit number 74.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, now, if we could please have Map 19, which bears ERN 0618-6714.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Begovic, do you see the map on the screen in front of you?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can you please tell us, on the July 1995 second action, where your combat group started from on that day?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Probably from Svinjasnica, over here in the direction of Kesten.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And can you, please, if you see it on the map, underline or circle Svinjasnica.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Begovic, can you please tell the Trial Chamber what happened with respect to the action that was undertaken in July 1995 by the combat group of which you were the emir?

utterances.speaker: MS. VIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, if something did happen. That is my objection.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Let me try this.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. Begovic, in July 1995, this second action, did it actually take place? Did it actually start?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, it did.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can you tell us approximately when in July, whether it was beginning, middle, end?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I don't know exactly what part of the month it was.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: You told us a few minutes ago, as reflected on page 80, line 6, that there was a location known as Trigonometre, "or something like that," you said. Do you see that location on this map?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can you tell the Trial Chamber what your combat group did and where it went in July 1995 while undertaking this action?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: There were still combat groups penetrating the line in a number of places, which we managed to penetrate in about half an hour. And we advanced, that is to say, my group advanced as far as the village of Kesten.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can you please, sir, circle the village of Kesten?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Do you remember, Mr. Begovic, the approximate route that your combat group took in going from Svinjasnica to Kesten?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I cannot say that with precision. I can just draw a straight line, but not the actual route through the field.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Okay. That would be perfect, then, under these circumstances. If you could draw a straight arrow, simply indicating the direction that your unit, your combat group went in the July 1995 action.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And please put arrowheads on there to indicate which direction you went, so that we can later make sense of this map.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And if you could please put a number "1" next to that arrow. Right below it, if you could write the number "1."

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Now, approximately, how long did your combat group remain in Kesten on that day?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: We were there, not in the village proper, but at a hill after the village for some four to five days, staying at the line, also digging trenches, fortifying positions.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: During this time period, when this action took place, and in the four or five days afterwards, at any point in time did you have any communication with Muatez?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Well, there were some others there, too. There were some Bosniak lads that we liaised with, had communication with. I don't remember whether I actually talked to Muatez as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Who were these "Bosniak lads" that you liaised with and had communication with?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Well, we were often in touch with Adnan Pezo and with Muatez as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And for the benefit of the Trial Chamber, who is Adnan Pezo?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Well, he was a Bosniak who was slightly more higher ranking than the rest of us in the detachment were. What his actual duty was, however, I don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. Begovic, after your unit or your combat group, excuse me, remained in the Kesten vicinity for a few days, where did you go next?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: After that, we went to Livade by way of Krcevine again; and then from Livade, we went to -- we went home.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Okay. Could you please circle Krcevine on the map?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, again, draw an approximate arrow from Kesten to Krcevine, indicating the direction that your unit went in leaving Kesten, and place the number "2" next to that arrow, please.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And I understand that Livade is not on this map, but if you could please draw an arrow from Krcevine in the general direction of Livade, and then place a number "3" next to that arrow, please.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Well, I don't see well enough to be able to indicate the direction. I don't know the exact direction. I don't see Livade on the map, and I can't do it. There were so many roads here in this area that one could take, that one could walk on.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Okay. Let's turn our attention, then, to the third action, as you've described it, which you told us was September -- well, before I do that, Mr. Begovic, were you aware of any -- other than this July 1995 action that we've talked about right now, to your knowledge, were there any other military actions in the vicinity of Krcevine and Kesten after the action you've told us about in July 1995?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No, I don't know that. I know nothing about anything of the kind.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Let's turn, then, sir, to the third action.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HARHOFF
utterances.text: Before we do so, Mr. Mundis, I'm not exactly sure if we have heard a lot of what happened, actually, in Kesten. We heard that the witness's combat group took off from Svinjasnica and moved towards Kesten, but what happened there? Was there actually combat activities? Was there Serb resistance in Kesten, and did you drive them out? What happened?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Those villages were empty. There were no troops there, there were no villagers there; and then they were small, it was just five or six houses. And the same goes for Krcevine, it was just a matter of five or six houses; not more than that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HARHOFF
utterances.text: Maybe I was misled to expect that there would have been some real combat activities, but that was not the case, I understand.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Proceed, Mr. Mundis.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Before I turn to September 1995, Mr. Begovic, do you know the location that you told us, that you remained around Kesten for four or five days, what location or feature were you at during that time period when you remained in the vicinity of Kesten?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I don't know exactly what the name of the locality was. It was right outside Kesten.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Do you see or can you mark with an "X" the location just outside Kesten where you were for these four days or so?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I'm not able to do that. I don't know where we were exactly.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: I would ask that this map be captured and admitted into evidence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: The map is captured, and it is admitted into evidence. May it please be given an exhibit number.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, that will be Exhibit number 75.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Yes, Mr. Mundis.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Let's turn now, Mr. Begovic, to the September 1995 action. What was your role with respect to that military action in September of 1995?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: The same. I was the emir of a combat group. I participated in the action at Paljenik.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, again, Mr. Begovic, with respect to this military action, September 1995, how many men were in your combat group?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Up to 20, the same. The number remained.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And were the 20 men in your combat group Bosniaks, or Bosniaks and Arabs? What was the makeup of your combat group?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Before any action, an Arab or two would be added to the groups. Otherwise, when there were no combat actions, there would only be Bosniaks in the groups.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Do you know, Mr. Begovic, why an Arab or two would be added to the groups before action?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Or more than two. I don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: With respect to the September 1995 action, what was the tasking or assignment given to your combat group?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: My group was tasked with breaking through the lines at Paljenik and to take control of it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, again, sir, who gave you that assignment or task?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Muatez.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Where was he when he gave you that tasking?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I don't remember.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Perhaps, if the witness can be shown Map 12 from the Court binder, 0618-6707, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. Begovic, while that's coming up onto the screen, can you please tell the Trial Chamber where your combat group was -- well, let me ask a preparatory question: This September 1995 action, did it actually take place? Did it actually occur?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And on the day -- do you remember the date of that combat action or military action?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: On the day that this action began, where was your combat group first thing in the morning? Where did you start from?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Again, from Svinjasnica.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Now, perhaps, if we could have this map enlarged in the centre part of the map.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. Begovic, do you see the location Svinjasnica, where your unit started from?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can you please circle that location using the electronic pen?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Begovic, you told us that your task was to go to the location known as Paljenik. Do you see that on the map?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I do.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can you tell the Trial Chamber what happened on that day with respect to the tasking that you had been given?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: My group successfully carried out the assignment given to it. We pushed the enemy back away from the area of Paljenik.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can you please circle Paljenik on the map, if you see it?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, again, can you please draw an arrow and place the number "1" next to it, to indicate the general direction your unit went in on that day in reaching Paljenik?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Do you want a straight line again?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Exactly, please.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And if you could draw little arrowheads and the number "1" next to that, please.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Now, how long did it take your combat group to take the Paljenik feature?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Half an hour, maybe less.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And how long after taking that feature did your combat group remain on Paljenik?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: We stayed for about two or three hours, sometime after noon.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: During the time period that you were on this feature, Paljenik, did you have any communication with the emir or military emir of the El Mujahedin Detachment?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I did.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And can you tell the Trial Chamber what you were told to do and by whom?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Once we managed to occupy the Paljenik elevation, we went to the other side of the hill, and Emir told us to stay there for a while, until further notice.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And when you say "Emir," which emir told you that?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Muatez.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And how long did you stay on the other side of the hill, pending this further communication?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: We stayed for about an hour or two, and then the emir, Muatez, ordered that we continue further down towards the road.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And when you say "down towards the road," was there any particular point at the road that you were directed to go towards?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Later, I found out that the place was called Stog, but at first I didn't know where we were heading to.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: If you see the place called Stog on this map, could you please circle it?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: The letters are very small. I think this is it. [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And, again, could you please draw a straight arrow and place a circle and a "2" on it, to indicate the general direction your combat unit went in from Paljenik to Stog?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And place the number "2" next to that, please.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. President, I would ask that this image be captured, given an exhibit number, and be admitted into evidence, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: This image is admitted into evidence. May it please be captured and be given an exhibit number.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be Exhibit number 76.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Begovic, do you know why your combat group was ordered to go to Stog?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I don't know why we got the order then. It was only logical for us to come down the hill and to the road.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: At any point on that day in September 1995, did you see your military emir, Muatez?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: I did. I saw him in Stog.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Did you speak to him in Stog on that occasion?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: How long did you remain in Stog on that day?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: We arrived in Stog in the afternoon. We were told - I don't know by whom - that Alija Izetbegovic was to come to visit us, together with Sakib Mahmuljin. However, we waited there until it got dark, and it didn't happen. We were then told to go home to rest. It was usually like that. After every action, we were allowed to go home to rest.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And did you, in fact, on that evening, go home to rest?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Where did you go? When you say "home," where did you go?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Home, my home.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Suhi Dol?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, Suhi Dol.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Okay. Now, I would ask, with the assistance of the usher, the witness be shown document PT02152. PT02152.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. Begovic, do you see this document in front of you? You see the document on the screen in front of you, sir?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: You were shown this document yesterday, and that was the first time you had ever seen it; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, I never saw it before that.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Do you see your name on this document, sir?

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Can you tell the Trial Chamber the number that's next to your name, and for the record?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Begovic --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Wait a minute. Is that 36? I see 36 is "Begovic, Mehmedalija."

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: That is the father's name, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Sinan.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Sinan.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: The column in the middle is the father's name, and then the name of the actual person.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: That's fine. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Mr. Begovic, could you indicate, as in the earlier list - and this will be the last document we show you today - could you please indicate the numbers next to the corresponding names of individuals whom you served with in the El Mujahedin Detachment during the period you were with that unit, please? Just the numbers.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: The people I know; is that what you mean?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Exactly, the names of the people you know.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: If you could go to the next page, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Next page, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Next page, please.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: There are no numbers here.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: If you could indicate the names of anyone that you know who's contained on this page.

utterances.speaker: SINAN BEGOVIC
utterances.text: Raif Omerovic, Abdumelik Basic, Ishak Aganovic, Adil Bosnic, Omer Basic, Dzevad Rujanac, Mirna Sagic [phoen], Ramiz Hodzic, Azir Begonovic, Enver Kozlic. That's it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Finally, the last page of the document, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: And for the record, this is the document bearing ERN number 0416-0654, simply because some of the numbers may be the same from the previous pages.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Number 1, number 6, number 12, 13, 17, 24, 28, 31. That's it.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Your Honour, I note the time. I have two more documents to show the witness, which I would propose we do tomorrow. It shouldn't take me more than ten minutes to complete the direct examination. I apologise for going longer than I had anticipated.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Mundis. Mr. Begovic, you are still going to come back here tomorrow, and you are still under oath, so make sure that you don't communicate with anybody about the case. The Court will adjourn until tomorrow at quarter past 2.00 in Courtroom I, not here.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: If I could, Your Honour, before you rise, I would tender this document into evidence. I don't want to leave that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Okay. You've been turning pages here. Is it the one document?

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: It is indeed.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: May this document be admitted into evidence and be given an exhibit number, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, that will be Exhibit number 77.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Court adjourns.
